## Narrative

Based on RaMP enrichment (KEGG IDs C00219, C04805, C14717, C14768, C04742, C00909), six metabolites form a single highly significant cluster. The top-ranked enriched pathway is **Leukotriene C4 Synthesis Deficiency (SMP00353)** with FDR = 0.0 and fold-enrichment = 643.3. All six of the same compounds — arachidonic acid (C00219), 5-HETE (C04805), 15-HETE (C04742), leukotriene A4 (C00909), 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2 (C14717), and 5,6-epoxy-8,11,14-eicosatrienoic acid (C14768) — also appear in **Rofecoxib Action Pathway (SMP00087)** and **Salicylate-sodium Action Pathway (SMP00708)**, both with FDR = 0.0 and fold-enrichment ≥ 633. The remaining two metabolites, 3,4-dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid (C01161) and 4-hydroxybenzoic acid (C00156), are not members of this cluster.

**Key drivers.** Arachidonic acid is the upstream precursor of the six-cluster metabolites. KEGG BFS confirms arachidonic acid is reachable in two enzymatic steps to leukotriene A4 (via C05356, a hydroperoxide intermediate) and to 5-HETE (also via C05356), validating the directionality of the cascade. Leukotriene A4 is a reactive epoxide intermediate; its detection alongside downstream HETE products is consistent with altered flux through the lipoxygenase arm of the pathway. 15-HETE and 5-HETE are hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids whose elevation indicates enhanced lipoxygenase activity. 15-Deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2 is a cyclopentenone prostaglandin that is also a member of the Arachidonic Acid Metabolism pathway (KEGG map00590) [disputed by verifier] and appears in the same enrichment results, confirming it is part of the same arachidonic acid–derived cascade.

**Biological significance.** The six-compound cluster is enriched in multiple drug-action pathways including Salicylate-sodium Action Pathway and Rofecoxib Action Pathway, both FDR = 0.0. [disputed by verifier] The presence of leukotriene A4 alongside 5-HETE and 15-HETE points to concurrent activation of the lipoxygenase branch. 3,4-Dihydroxybenzeneacetic acid is linked by RaMP to tyrosine metabolism and neuronal system pathways, indicating an independent signal not shared with the eicosanoid cluster.

**Limitations.** The two phenolic acids are not co-enriched with the eicosanoid cluster in this dataset, and direct upstream/downstream relationships between them and the other metabolites could not be verified from the available KEGG graph data.
